skill.name: minimax-pdf
skill.description: Create, fill, and reformat polished PDFs with a token-based design system. MiniMax PDF builds covers, body pages, charts, math blocks, forms, and final merged PDFs through local Python and Node scripts.
skill.summary: Create print-ready PDFs, fill PDF forms, and reformat documents with a consistent design system.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, design terminology, expected output-file writes, and code-fence parsing. Confirmed issues are the real package-manager execution paths, Google Fonts network loading, and subprocess-based Playwright setup. Additional semantic review found runtime dependency installation and unescaped cover HTML rendering risks.

remediation.issue: Automatic dependency installation can modify the host environment.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic pip and npm installation from runtime paths. Document dependencies and require explicit user approval before installing them.

remediation.issue: Playwright setup invokes npm and npx through subprocess paths.
remediation.suggestion: Require Playwright and Chromium to be preinstalled, avoid shell execution, and resolve binaries from trusted configured paths.

remediation.issue: Cover HTML interpolates user-controlled text and image values without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: HTML-escape all text fields, validate color and URL inputs, and restrict cover images to approved local paths or safe URL schemes.

remediation.issue: Cover rendering can contact Google Fonts at render time.
remediation.suggestion: Offer an offline font mode, vendor approved fonts, or clearly disclose network font loading before rendering.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Dependency Installation
semantic_findings.description: Several scripts install Python packages, Playwright, or Chromium at runtime, including --break-system-packages and global npm install paths. This can modify the user environment and download code from package registries without a separate approval step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The install commands are explicit and appear in multiple runtime paths. The risk is environmental modification and supply-chain download, not inferred malicious intent.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped HTML in Cover Rendering
semantic_findings.description: User-controlled title, subtitle, abstract, author, date, and image values are interpolated into cover HTML before Playwright renders it. Without escaping or URL validation, crafted input could inject markup or trigger unexpected local or remote resource loading.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The f-string insertions are direct and Playwright renders the resulting local HTML. Impact depends on browser restrictions, but the injection surface is clear.

high_findings.description: User-controlled title, subtitle, abstract, author, date, and image values are interpolated into cover HTML before Playwright renders it. Without escaping or URL validation, crafted input could inject markup or trigger unexpected local or remote resource loading.
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: The f-string insertions are direct and Playwright renders the resulting local HTML. Impact depends on browser restrictions, but the injection surface is clear.

content.user_title: Create Polished PDFs With MiniMax PDF
content.value_statement: Plain PDF pipelines often produce generic layouts. MiniMax PDF creates, fills, and reformats PDFs with consistent design tokens and print-ready output.
actual_capabilities: Generates a complete PDF from title, document type, author, date, and structured content.
Builds styled cover pages with document-type palettes, typography, and cover patterns.
Renders body pages with headings, paragraphs, tables, images, charts, math, flowcharts, code blocks, and bibliographies.
Inspects fillable PDF fields and writes provided values into supported form controls.
Converts Markdown, text, JSON, or PDF input into a restyled PDF workflow.
Merges cover and body PDFs and reports basic page-count and size checks.
limitations: Requires Python, Node.js, Playwright, ReportLab, pypdf, and sometimes matplotlib.
The fix command can install dependencies and should be run only with user approval.
Cover rendering may load Google Fonts or user-provided cover images from the network.
PDF reformatting is best-effort and may not preserve complex source layouts.

use_cases.title: Client Proposal Packaging
use_cases.description: Turn proposal content into a polished PDF with a custom cover, section styling, tables, and a final merged file.

use_cases.title: Research Report Production
use_cases.description: Create reports with charts, math, references, and consistent typography without manually designing every page.

use_cases.title: Form Completion Workflow
use_cases.description: Inspect fillable PDFs, map field names, and produce completed copies while preserving the original layout.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use minimax-pdf to create a professional PDF report titled [title]. Include a cover, three sections, and a concise summary.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Form PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use minimax-pdf to inspect [form.pdf], list the fields, then fill it with the values I provide after inspection.

prompt_templates.title: Reformat an Existing Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Use minimax-pdf to reformat [source.md] as a [type] PDF with a cover, improved structure, and a restrained accent color.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Data-Rich PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use minimax-pdf to create a client-ready PDF with sections, tables, charts, math, a bibliography, and a custom cover image.

output_examples.input: Create a strategy review PDF from structured section notes.
output_examples.output: A print-ready PDF with a cover page, section headings, callouts, tables, charts, and a merged final file.

output_examples.input: Fill a vendor onboarding PDF with approved company details.
output_examples.output: A completed PDF plus a field summary showing filled fields, validation errors, and missing field names.

output_examples.input: Reformat a Markdown report into a polished proposal.
output_examples.output: A redesigned PDF with standardized spacing, typography, cover art, and body pages generated from the source document.

best_practices: Run the field inspection step before filling a PDF form.
Provide clean source content and specify the document type, audience, and desired tone.
Review dependency installation, network font loading, and output paths before running scripts.
anti_patterns: Do not run the automatic fix command without user approval.
Do not pass sensitive local file paths as cover images unless the output is trusted.
Do not expect complex scanned PDFs to reformat with perfect structure.

faq.question: Can it create PDFs from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can build a cover, body pages, and final merged PDF from structured content.

faq.question: Can it fill existing PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It inspects field names first, then writes values into text, checkbox, dropdown, and radio fields.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Body pages use local system fonts, but cover fonts may load from Google Fonts unless changed.

faq.question: What tools does it need?
faq.answer: It needs Python, Node.js, Playwright, ReportLab, pypdf, and optionally matplotlib for charts and math.

faq.question: Can it reformat a PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, but extraction is best-effort. Complex layouts and scanned documents may need manual cleanup.

faq.question: Is it safe to auto-install dependencies?
faq.answer: Automatic installation changes the local environment. Review the commands and approve them before use.
